title: Direct and Indirect Speech Quiz 147: Mixed Practice
content:
# Direct / Indirect Speech – 34 (Mixed)

## Quiz 147

1. She said to me, “I thank you.”
2. She said to me, “Thank you.”
3. King Midas said, “Daughter, fetch me some water from the well in my golden jug.”

## Answers to Quiz 146 are:

1. She thanked me.
2. The notice welcomed us/visitors to Punjab.
3. She called him a liar.
4. She called the boy stupid.

To be continued…
